company.name: Legora
company.one_line: Collaborative AI for lawyers: an agentic operating system for legal work, sold to law firms and in-house legal teams.

features.name: Agent
features.does: Plans, executes, reviews and delivers end-to-end legal work.

features.name: Monitors
features.does: Continuously scans global regulation and surfaces what matters before it bites.

features.name: Lists
features.does: Generates structured lists from documents so AI output connects to legal workflows.

features.name: Tabular review
features.does: Reviews many documents side by side in a table.

features.name: Portal
features.does: Delivers work to clients and collaborators.

features.name: Security posture
features.does: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, GDPR and HIPAA, with no AI training on customer data.
